info.title: Fenergo Nebula Data Migration Query
info.description:
**Data migration Query API**:
Data migration Query API provides both configurational and operational methods related to the clients data migration.
**Data migration Query API provides**:
  • The ability to search for data migration, task and stage statuses, files added to each data migration and error files containing failed row imports.

get.description:
This method gets the metadata information around a created migration including data around each stage and task The tenant id is mandatory and should be included as the header X-TENANT-ID

Required permissions:
Following permissions are required: DataMigrationAdministrator

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Id of an existing migration

parameters.name: X-TENANT-ID
parameters.description: The UiD of the tenant representing organization

200.description:
An instance of the Fenergo.Nebula.DataMigration.Query.Application.Dto.DataMigrationDto class representing the migration metadata with the specified 
            id, if found; otherwise, `null`.

400.description: Bad request. The request has missing/invalid values

messages.message: Access denied. Following permissions are required: Permission1, Permission2
